csv_project_name: AE for EMS Administrative Office and Station
csv_scope_of_work: Beaufort County is issuing this Request for Qualifications from professional architectural and engineering firms for Design and Construction Administration services for the construction of a new Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Administrative office and station. The Administrative Office and Station #1 is located at 2727 Depot Road, Beaufort, SC 29902. The County is considering several options for location of the new facility while staying in the general area due to the need to provide service coverage to response zones. Options may include multiple storied buildings, separate locations for administration and Station #1, co-locating with the City of Beaufort at one of their fire stations, or rebuilding on site.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering
